name: code-viewer-demo
description: Visible code chunking — point it at a codebase, see how it chunks, tune chunk size live. Phase 1 of a code-architecture understanding tool.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
